title: Towards Robust Universal Information Extraction: Dataset, Evaluation, and Solution

model.params_source: resolution plan (paper Sec. 5.2 states temperature 0 and max output 640 for its own model's inference; assumed for the API baselines)

task.subset_rule: all 1,000 RUIE-Bench original NER samples (134 ACE05-Ent, 294 CoNLL03, 572 WikiANN)
task.approximation: The 10 demonstrations are a seeded random draw from the corresponding source training set (the authors' draw is unlisted); the release may omit the ACE05 portion (LDC licence).

items.source: RUIE-Bench subset on Google Drive (file id 1xCp6hEvEQxXYNe9aunVsOY3Mb2OXC2qi), linked from https://github.com/ICT-GoKnow/RobustUIE; demonstrations from the CoNLL03 / WikiANN / ACE05 training sets

fields.label: entities [{name, type}] with dataset-specific type set

items.license: unknown (release states copyright-restricted portions are withheld)

prompt.user_template:
## Task Objective
Perform Named Entity Recognition (NER) on input sentences to extract entities of these types:
##Entity Types:
{entity_types_block}
## Output Formatting
1. Return a JSON list of entities
2. Each entity must include:
- **Type**: Entity category (exact uppercase labels)
- **Name**: Original text span
3. Return empty list if no entities found
## Examples (10-shot)
{examples_block}
## Current Task
Input: {test_sentence}
Output:

placeholders.entity_types_block: one line per type of the sample's source dataset: '{entity_type}: {description}'
placeholders.examples_block: ten lines '{k}. Input: {example sentence}\nOutput: {recognition result}' with the JSON list format above, drawn with seed 20260907 from the source dataset's training set

prompt.few_shot: k=10 seeded from the source training set (Appendix D: 'randomly sampled from the training set')
prompt.source_location: Appendix D, Table 7 (Prompt for Few-Shot NER)
prompt.verbatim: full (template); the demonstrations and type descriptions are filled from the release

output.parse: json field: first JSON list in the completion, elements with keys name/type (case-insensitive keys accepted)
output.postprocess: strip; type upper-cased; unparsable output = empty prediction

metric.name: micro_f1
metric.definition: span-based Micro F1 over all 1,000 samples: an entity is correct only if both its text span (offsets) and type match the gold annotation (Sec. 5.1).

open_points: The public RUIE-Bench release omits copyright-restricted data (likely the 134 ACE05 samples); decide whether to run on the released subset (~866 samples, approximate comparison) or obtain ACE05 under an LDC licence.

The Google Drive id resolves to RUIE-Bench.zip (size not reported by the redirect); field names, entity-type descriptions and the 10-shot demonstrations (drawn from the CoNLL03 / WikiANN / ACE05 training sets, the last LDC-gated) must be confirmed by a human before a hook can be written
notes: Offsets: the paper scores span offsets; with text-only model output, map each predicted span to its first occurrence in the sentence.
